description: Tell the Crook tab Claude Code runs in what it is doing: running when a prompt is sent and around every tool, needs-input with the notification's text whenever it stops to ask, idle when it is done. Each command does nothing unless it runs in a Crook pane with the crook binary reachable ($CROOK_BIN, else crook on PATH).

hooks.command: [ "$TERM_PROGRAM" = Crook ] || [ -n "$CROOK_PANE_ID" ] || exit 0; crook=$CROOK_BIN; [ -x "$crook" ] || crook=$(command -v crook) || exit 0; exec "$crook" --agent running --title -
